channel.title: AI Blocks: new and changed skills, workflows and minds
channel.description: The newest free AI skills, workflows, prompts, agents and minds on AI Blocks, and the ones that changed most recently.

item.title: Expense report builder
item.description: Paste receipts and notes. Get an expense report with totals by category, a reason for each line and gaps to fix.

item.title: Hourly rate calculator
item.description: Give it your target pay, costs and billable hours. Get an hourly rate, a day rate and a project price.

item.title: Mortgage affordability checker
item.description: Share your pay, costs, deposit and quoted rates. Get monthly payments, a higher-rate stress test and questions for your lender.

item.title: Podcast show notes writer
item.description: Paste your transcript or notes. Get show notes: title, summary, key points, links mentioned and a call to action.

item.title: Remote work policy writer
item.description: Say how your team works from home. Get a plain remote work policy and a list of choices left to make.
item.category: Hire and look after your people

item.title: Self-assessment tax return checklist
item.description: Say how you earned money. Get records to gather, totals to work out, an order of work and questions for your accountant.

item.title: Side hustle idea finder
item.description: Share your skills, spare hours and budget. Get three to five side hustle ideas, each with a first customer and a cheap test.

item.title: Tax set-aside planner
item.description: Give the tax share your accountant quotes. Get a rule for each payment, a place to keep it and dates to check.

item.title: Workflow diagram and change planner
item.description: Share a workflow or goal. Get it drawn as a diagram, each hand-off checked, and changes with reasons.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: 3D map scene developer
item.description: Plan a 3D web map scene with terrain, buildings or LiDAR, lighting, camera and speed checks for Cesium or ArcGIS. Get a build plan you can follow.

item.title: Accessibility auditor
item.description: Audit a web page or app for accessibility barriers. Get findings tied to WCAG 2.2, a test plan for keyboard and screen readers, and a fix list.

item.title: Accounts payable reviewer
item.description: Paste invoices, approved vendors and your approval rule. Get each invoice checked for duplicates and mismatches, plus a payment proposal to approve.
item.category: Reconcile accounts and close the books

item.title: Ad creative strategist agent
item.description: Get Google search ad headlines, Meta ad text and a test plan from your offer and buyer. Draft ads for Google, Meta and Performance Max to review.

item.title: Aging parent care coordinator
item.description: Keep an aging parent's medicines, appointments and care team straight. Get a care plan, who to tell about what, and questions for the doctor.

item.title: AI agent identity designer
item.description: Design how your AI agents prove who they are, what they may do and what they did, with a threat list, permission map and tamper-proof log.

item.title: AI agent team planner
item.description: Plan a software build run by a team of AI agents: the phases, who hands what to whom, pass or fail quality checks and when to stop and ask you.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: AI answer visibility architect
item.description: Check if AI crawlers can find and read your site. Get a scorecard, a robots.txt for AI bots and an llms.txt file. Paste your robots.txt.
item.category: Get found in search and AI answers

item.title: AI citation visibility planner
item.description: Find out if ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity name you or a rival. Get a citation table, lost questions and a ranked fix plan.
item.category: Get found in search and AI answers

item.title: AI data repair engineer
item.description: Fix messy data with a few tested rules, not row-by-row. You get fix formulas, a change log and a review list of risky rows.
item.category: Analyse data and explain the results

item.title: AI feature planner
item.description: Get a plan to add an AI feature to your product, from data check to launch, with bias tests, monitoring and a retraining trigger.

item.title: AI model routing planner
item.description: Plan which AI model handles each task in your app, with a spend cap, a backup model and a safe trial before any switch. Bring your setup.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: AI search visibility reviewer
item.description: Check if an AI browsing agent can book, buy or sign up on your site. Get a task scorecard, the steps where it gets stuck and fixes.
item.category: Get found in search and AI answers

item.title: AI-written code security reviewer
item.description: Paste AI-written app code. Get a ranked list of leaked keys, open database rules and prompt injection holes, each with the fix and a rescan list.

item.title: Analytics report writer
item.description: Turn your sales, ad or customer export into a plain analytics report with trends, customer groups, ad returns and what to do next.
item.category: Analyse data and explain the results

item.title: Anthropologist
item.description: Design a believable culture for your story or game, or check one for clichés. Get kinship, rituals, beliefs and tensions that fit together.

item.title: API platform engineer agent
item.description: Get a plan for a public or partner API with contract rules, a breaking-change list, a versioning policy, rate limits and an SDK plan.

item.title: API test planner
item.description: Turn your API spec into a test plan with edge cases, auth checks and failure cases, plus starter test code to run on a test server.

item.title: App store optimizer agent
item.description: Plan your app store listing for more installs. Get keywords, new title and description, a screenshot plan and a test order. Share your listing.
item.category: Get found in search and AI answers

item.title: App translation readiness reviewer
item.description: Find what stops your app working in other languages: hardcoded text, plurals, dates and right-to-left layout. Get ranked fixes.

item.title: Application security reviewer
item.description: Get a threat model and secure code review for your feature, with bugs to fix before merge, hardening tips and security requirements you can test.

item.title: Art pipeline planner
item.description: Plan a game art pipeline with budgets for models, textures and effects, LOD and import rules, and a review routine, for any engine or platform.

item.title: Automation governance planner
item.description: Decide if a business process should be automated. Get a verdict, the risks, a safe design with fallback and the tests to pass before go-live.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: Backend architect agent
item.description: Get a backend design with a right-sized setup, data tables, an API outline, a failure plan and a safe way to change the database.

item.title: Baidu SEO specialist
item.description: Get a Baidu SEO plan for China: setup checks, Chinese keyword groups and content fixes, with the first steps to take. Bring your site and goal.
item.category: Get found in search and AI answers

item.title: Behavior evidence reviewer
item.description: Get a psychology profile of a character or relationship, built on named theories, so their choices and clashes feel real and hold together.

item.title: Bilibili content planner
item.description: Get a Bilibili content plan: channel positioning, video series, titles and covers, danmaku moments and a launch checklist. Bring your channel or brand.

item.title: BIM and GIS integration planner
item.description: Plan how to bring a Revit or IFC model into GIS. Get a coordinate plan, attribute map, checks and an indoor or twin plan.

item.title: Blender add-on developer
item.description: Turn a repeated Blender chore into a Blender add-on plan and starter Python code. Check asset names, scale and materials before export.

item.title: Blockchain security reviewer
item.description: Paste your smart contract scope. Get an audit plan with reentrancy, oracle and access-control checks, ranked by how much user money is at risk.

item.title: Book co-author agent
item.description: Turn your voice notes and rough ideas into a book chapter in your own voice. Get a chapter blueprint, a versioned draft and notes on weak spots.

item.title: Brand consistency reviewer
item.description: Get a brand foundation document or a brand consistency check. See your purpose, voice and look in writing, or where your materials drift from them.

item.title: Budget and forecast analyst
item.description: Get a budget versus actual review with the reason behind each big gap, an updated full-year forecast and an action for each budget owner.
item.category: Plan budgets, costs and cash flow

item.title: Business strategist agent
item.description: Make one big business choice. Get a strategy brief with the problem, three options, risks, a clear pick and what you will not do.

item.title: Carousel content planner
item.description: Get a six-slide TikTok and Instagram carousel plan from your site: three hooks, slide text, image prompts and a caption. Bring your link.

item.title: Cash flow and expense analyst
item.description: Get a cash and expense review from your bank and card exports, with a cash forecast, the assumptions behind it and the weeks cash runs low.
item.category: Plan budgets, costs and cash flow

item.title: Change management consultant
item.description: Plan the people side of a new tool, process or re-org, with a stakeholder map, message plan and adoption checks. Describe the change and who it hits.

item.title: Chief of staff
item.description: Turn your task list and notes into a one-page state of play. Get what needs you now, the decisions waiting, the open hand-offs and one top priority.

item.title: China ecommerce operations planner
item.description: Get a China ecommerce plan for Taobao, Tmall, JD, Pinduoduo or Douyin Shop, with margin checks, ad plans and a 618 or Double 11 countdown.

item.title: China healthcare marketing reviewer
item.description: Check China healthcare ads and posts for banned claims before you publish. Get flagged lines, risk levels and safer rewrites. Not legal advice.
item.category: Check ads before they go live

item.title: China market localization planner
item.description: Turn China trend data into a market entry brief with platform picks, content templates and a week-by-week launch checklist for a small team.

item.title: China network engineer
item.description: Get a change plan for Huawei, H3C, Ruijie or Hillstone gear with pre-checks, exact commands, checks, rollback and MLPS 2.0 network notes.

item.title: China recruitment planner
item.description: Plan hiring in China, from job post and Boss Zhipin or Liepin channels to interviews, offer and a labour law check. Give it the role, city and budget.
item.category: Hire and look after your people

item.title: China supply chain planner
item.description: Plan how to buy from Chinese factories. Get a sourcing plan with supplier checks, total cost, an order split and a risk register with backups.

item.title: Chinese government bid planner
item.description: Check a Chinese government tender. Get a bid or no-bid view, a list of what could disqualify you and the security gaps to close first.

item.title: Civil design reviewer
item.description: Get a second look at a structural or foundation idea. See the code, loads and checks to run, and the questions for your licensed engineer.

item.title: Clinical evidence reviewer
item.description: Check every health claim in your deck, paper or product page. Each one is sorted as validated, directional or unvalidated, with a flag list.

item.title: Cloud cost analyst
item.description: Find where your cloud bill goes and what to cut safely. Get spend by owner, ranked savings with their risk, and what to commit to last.

item.title: Cloud security designer
item.description: Describe your AWS, Azure or GCP setup. Get a posture checklist by area, each gap ranked, and the guardrail to add so it can't happen again.

item.title: Code reviewer agent
item.description: Paste a code change and get a review of bugs, security, tests and clarity. Each point has the reason and a fix, ranked blocker, suggestion or nit.

item.title: Codebase history researcher
item.description: Find silent mismatches in code built over many AI sessions, such as reversed fallbacks, duplicate logic and stale docs, ranked by risk with files named.
item.category: Write down how work gets done

item.title: Codebase onboarding planner
item.description: Get a codebase onboarding map for any repo, with entry points, key files and how requests flow, built only from the code. Facts, no advice.
item.category: Write down how work gets done

item.title: Compliance auditor agent
item.description: Check your security setup against SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA or PCI-DSS. Get a gap table, an auditor proof list and a fix order.

item.title: Connected notes planner
item.description: Turn loose notes into a linked knowledge base. Get a four-rule check, link suggestions, index entries and a daily log line. Paste a note.
item.category: Write down how work gets done

item.title: Content writer
item.description: Get a content plan and channel drafts from one idea: blog, video and social posts, each with its audience goal and facts to check. Bring your topic.

item.title: Conversion tracking planner
item.description: Plan or fix your ad conversion tracking across GA4, Google Ads and Meta. Get an event list, a double-count check and a step-by-step test plan.

item.title: Corporate training designer agent
item.description: Plan staff training from a real work problem. Get measurable goals, a module outline, practice exercises and a way to check behavior changed.

item.title: Credential storage and rotation reviewer
item.description: List where your secrets live. Get each one's risk, a rotation date and the storage fix, plus a leak-response runbook for when one gets out.

item.title: Cross-border ecommerce planner
item.description: Get a cross-border ecommerce plan for Amazon, Shopee, Temu or TikTok Shop with margin per product, compliance to-dos and a launch order.

item.title: Cultural fit reviewer
item.description: Review your forms, copy or image prompts for cultural blind spots. Get ranked exclusion risks and copy-ready fixes for the markets you serve.

item.title: Customer community planner
item.description: Plan a WeChat or WeCom customer community, from first contact to repeat purchase. Give it your brand, customer base and goal.

item.title: Customer service writer
item.description: Get a customer service reply draft, the steps to fix the issue and a clear call on when to escalate. Paste the message and your policy.

item.title: Customer success planner
item.description: Get an account health read, churn risks and a plan to keep one customer, from onboarding to renewal. Give it the account facts and what happens next.

item.title: Customer support response writer
item.description: Turn a customer support ticket into a reply, a likely cause, an escalate-or-not call and a help-article note. Paste the ticket and what you know.

item.title: Data pipeline designer
item.description: Get a data pipeline design with raw, cleaned and report-ready layers, quality checks, freshness targets, alerts and a plan for when loads fail.

item.title: Data privacy officer
item.description: Review one way you use customer data under GDPR or CCPA. Get the duties that apply, the proof you lack and what to fix first.

item.title: Data visualization engineer agent
item.description: Pick the right chart for your data and check it does not mislead. Get a plan with axes, colours and a pass or fail check.
item.category: Analyse data and explain the results

item.title: Database performance analyst
item.description: Get a ranked list of slow database queries, missing indexes and risky schema choices, with safe fixes you can test on a copy first.

item.title: Database recovery planner
item.description: Check that your database can be restored and will fail over safely. Get a backup test plan, a failover drill and a safe way to change tables.

item.title: Deployment pipeline designer
item.description: Turn manual deploys into an automated pipeline that tests, ships and rolls back, with alerts and a rollout order. Bring your stack and current steps.

item.title: Desktop app engineer agent
item.description: Get a plan for an Electron or Tauri desktop app with the runtime to pick, safe setup rules, code signing, auto-updates and size limits.

item.title: Developer community builder agent
item.description: Get a developer community plan for Discord or GitHub Discussions: channels, rules, contributor tiers and health checks. Bring your product and community.

item.title: Developer experience reviewer
item.description: Get a developer onboarding friction report. See the steps where new developers get stuck, rewritten error messages and fixes ranked by effort.

item.title: Developer outreach planner
item.description: Get a developer relations plan: the top fixes to getting started, tutorial ideas, community actions and a monthly feedback report.

item.title: Developer platform designer
item.description: Plan an internal developer platform with easy paths for new services, self-serve requests and adoption checks. Bring your team's pain points.

item.title: Developer tools engineer
item.description: Design a command-line tool your team will like: clear commands, helpful errors, fast startup and safe updates. Bring your scripts and goal.

item.title: Document generation planner
item.description: Get a script that builds a PDF, Word, slide or Excel file from your data, with the right library for the format and a template you can reuse.

item.title: Document layout engine designer
item.description: Plan how YAML or JSON data becomes a paged PDF. Get a layout for each section, page-break rules and checks that no field is dropped or split.

item.title: Douyin content planner
item.description: Get a Douyin marketing plan for China: video hooks, scripts, a weekly calendar and a livestream lineup. Bring your product, region and budget.

item.title: Drone mapping specialist
item.description: Plan a drone mapping job: flight settings, ground control points, processing steps and accuracy checks for orthomosaics, terrain models and 3D meshes.

item.title: Drupal Commerce developer
item.description: Plan or review a Drupal Commerce store, from products and checkout to payments, tax and orders, with a test list to clear before go-live.

item.title: Drupal performance engineer agent
item.description: Find why your Drupal site is slow. Get ranked fixes for caching, slow pages, images and hosting, each with the evidence and a before and after check.

item.title: Electrical design reviewer
item.description: Get an electrical design review with checked units, sizing sums, standards and open risks. A licensed engineer must sign off before building.

item.title: Email marketing planner
item.description: Turn a messy contact list into an email plan: who gets what, when, with exit rules, a deliverability checklist and clicks-first measurement.

item.title: Email parsing engineer
item.description: Turn a messy email thread into who said what, decisions and tasks with owners. Or plan the pipeline that does it for many threads.

item.title: Embedded firmware engineer
item.description: Plan embedded firmware for ESP32, STM32 or Nordic chips: tasks, pin map, memory limits and failure handling. Bring your chip and goal.

item.title: Engineering documentation writer
item.description: Get developer docs drafted from your code and notes, such as a README, API reference or tutorial, plus a list of claims to verify.
item.category: Write down how work gets done

item.title: Executive summary generator
item.description: Turn a long report into a 325 to 475 word executive summary with findings, impact, ranked actions and owners. Paste your report.
item.category: Write down how work gets done

item.title: Experiment tracker
item.description: Plan an A/B test before launch, then read the result. Get sample size, stop rules, a go or stop call and the lesson to keep.

item.title: Family care visit coordinator
item.description: Prepare questions for a relative's care visit, record what the care team said and draft a short family handoff. You review it; nothing is sent.

item.title: FedRAMP and RMF compliance planner
item.description: Plan FedRAMP or NIST RMF authorization for a cloud system. Get its impact level, scope notes, control gaps and a fix list for your assessor.
